greet.text: Aye? If it's flour you're after, come back when the wheel's turning. Merra's poorly and I've no heart for the mill.

options.text: We'll ask the herbalist about her.

deliver.text: Is that Wenna's bottle? Gods be thanked.

options.text: Three drops in warm milk, she says. And none for you.

thanks.text: Ha! That sounds like her. Take this, it isn't much. And if you're ever hungry, there's always bread at the mill.

after.text: Merra's sitting up and complaining about the state of the kitchen. Best sign there is.
